shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50
for f in index.html src/* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -A15 '"peerDependencies"' && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls styles; grep -A30 '"exports"' package.json | head -40; head -60 CHANGELOG.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && sed -n '/## Install/,/## Usage/p;/## Usage/,/## Development/p' README.md | head -120; grep -n '"./styles' -A3 package.json; grep -n 'sideEffects' -A5 package.json
grep -n -i 'theme\|provider\|migration' README.md | head -30; ls build/esm; cat build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80
cat guides/theming.md | head -120; echo =====; cat guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -200
cat components/controls/TextInput.md components/controls/PasswordInput.md components/Checkbox.md | grep -v '^$' | head -400

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && cat esm/components/controls/index.d.ts; cat esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; ls esm/components/layout

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && grep -v '^$' guides/layout.md | head -150; echo ====; grep -v '^$' components/Button.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,$p'; echo ===; grep -v '^$' components/Card.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,$p'; grep -v '^$' components/Text.md | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -80; ls layout/Box; grep -n 'padding\|width\|maxWidth\|as?' layout/Box/*.d.ts layout/types.d.ts | head -40; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "variant" Text/*.d.ts ../../components/Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n 'SpacingValue =\|SpacingToken\|type Space\b\|gap?' layout/types.d.ts layout/spacing/*.d.ts | head; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'header-1'" Text/ ../../ -l 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n "header-1\|subheader" Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls Text Text/*

mkdir -p .tmpchk && sed 's#/tmp/chk/\*.test.tsx#.tmpchk/*.test.tsx#' /tmp/chk/vitest.config.ts > .tmpchk/vitest.config.ts && cp /tmp/chk/ssr.test.tsx .tmpchk/ && npx vitest run --config .tmpchk/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E '<(input|label|button|h1|form)|Запомнить|Войти|Пароль|Email|✓|FAIL|Error|passed|failed' | head -30; rm -rf .tmpchk
echo 'dist/' >> .gitignore && rm -rf dist && npm audit 2>&1 | grep -E '^[a-z@].*  |Severity|depends on' | head -20; git status --short
